due_when.clears_when: Before NETTED-SLICES extends to bybit_2 + bybit_portfolio: the untracked-leg count on bybit_1 slice opens since merge is read and is 0, or the untracked-trail refusal is built.

observation.how_to_check: diag sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(sl_order_id IS NULL) FROM trades WHERE account_id='bybit_1' AND created_at >= <merge date> AND COALESCE(is_backtest,0)=0
observation.what: Count of bybit_1 slice opens since merge with sl_order_id NULL (untracked leg).

origin.ref: Lane NETTED-SLICES session_012ogCc58pJF5f9xFBLtjk1G, PR branch claude/netted-slices, 2026-10-15
origin.rerun: diag sql on trade_journal.db: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(sl_order_id IS NULL) FROM trades WHERE account_id='bybit_1' AND created_at >= <merge date> AND COALESCE(is_backtest,0)=0

what: NETTED-SLICES residual: a slice whose entry-time leg-id capture failed (sl_order_id NULL) is trailed through modify_open_order's LEGACY Partial add-a-leg path, which leaves its previous leg resting. On a single-position book that was a leg-count leak (BL-20260721 XRP LEGCAP); on a multi-slice book the stale leg is sized to this slice but can fire against the whole net -- it can close another slice's qty. Measure how often a slice account opens with an untracked leg before bybit_2 adoption; if > 0, the fix is to refuse trailing an untracked slice (or backfill-tpsl-leg-ids it) on slice accounts.
